posts.title: Practicing Again!
posts.description: I didn't realize it, but people actually missed me and my family a lot when we were away from the tennis courts. posts.title: The Future of "Tennis Life Lessons"
posts.description: I haven't written here in a while, mainly because I haven't been playing as much tennis. I do want to get outside again, and the weather is finally getting better.
